signIn.title: Your OpalaTex projects, on the go
signIn.body: Connect the Google account your desktop OpalaTex mirrors projects to. The app sees only the folders OpalaTex created.
signIn.devBody: Google authorization is an Android API. In a browser, paste an access token with the drive.file scope (it lasts an hour). Secrets are kept in this tab only.
signIn.hint10: Google does not recognise this build of the app. In the Google Cloud project that owns the desktop's OAuth client, create an OAuth client of type Android with the package name and SHA-1 below, and make sure the Google Drive API is enabled in that project. Changes can take a few minutes to apply.
signIn.hint16: The consent screen was closed or access was refused. If you did not cancel it: while the OAuth consent screen is in Testing, only the listed test users can authorize; and the Android OAuth client must be registered with the values below.
signIn.hint7: Google could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
signIn.hintOther: Check that an Android OAuth client is registered with the values below, in the same Google Cloud project as the desktop's client.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No mirrored projects in this Google account yet. Turn on Cloud sync for a project in the desktop app, let it finish a pass, then refresh.
projects.emptyHint: If the desktop already mirrors projects to this account, its OAuth client and this app's must belong to the same Google Cloud project.

project.noExport: This project has no conversations in Drive yet. Make sure "Sync conversations" is on in the desktop's Cloud sync panel.
project.exportNewer: The conversations were written by a newer OpalaTex. Update the app to read them.

chat.noModel: The desktop runs this project on “{{provider}}”, and the phone has no connection for it. Choose one of your models, or add that connection.
chat.noModelAtAll: No model is chosen for this chat yet.
chat.noProvider: The desktop’s model “{{model}}” does not name a provider. Choose a model for this chat.
chat.noBaseUrl: The "{{provider}}" connection has no address. Set it in Settings.
chat.notUploaded: Saved on the phone; it will upload when Drive is reachable.
chat.connectionRemoved: The connection this chat used was removed. Choose another model.

approval.body: The change is written to Google Drive. The desktop picks it up on its next sync.

files.binary: This file cannot be shown on the phone.
files.tooLarge: This file is too large to show on the phone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connectionsHint: Add the providers you use, with their API keys, and the models you want to pick from. Keys stay on this phone, encrypted with the Android Keystore; they are never uploaded. Each chat can use any of these models: tap the model name at the top of a chat.
settings.baseUrlHint: Leave empty for the provider's default.
settings.apiKeySaved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
settings.deviceHint: Shown on the desktop next to what this phone wrote.
settings.name: Name
settings.modelsEmpty: No models yet. Load them from the provider or type a name.

picker.title: Model for this chat
picker.empty: No model connection yet. Add a provider and its API key to start chatting.
picker.noModels: No models listed yet. Add them in Settings, or load them from the provider.

offline.title: Available offline
offline.off: Off: only the files you open are kept on this phone.
offline.skipped_one: {{count}} file is too large or cannot be shown on the phone, and stays online.
offline.skipped_other: {{count}} files are too large or cannot be shown on the phone, and stay online.
offline.failed: Saving stopped: {{message}} It continues on the next sync.
